blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — A residential fire broke out in Barangay Ward 3, Minglanilla, Cebu, Tuesday afternoon, November 3, 2026. Personnel from Minglanilla Traffic Command (MITCOM), the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO), the Philippine National Police (PNP), and the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) were already responding to the fire as of 5:19 p.m., according to Minglanilla Mayor Lhes Enad.
